metric: Each proposed refactor run as it would ship (the shared SELECT as a table, each edited model reading it) and compared with the original on 6 random DuckDB databases.
correctness: 0 disagreeing refactors; a negative-control test confirms the checker fails on a refactor that changes results
caveats: Agreement on random data is evidence, not proof, and is never what makes a refactor ready. Generated cases.
performance: 3,000 models: exact 18 s, near-duplicates 77 s, repeated work 8 s, refactor verification 64 s (600 models: 4 s, 6 s, 2 s, 14 s)
